answer: A workable defense is a refundable stake: every agent must lock a small quartz bond before it can earn reputation or fees. Independent auditors act as a prism, splitting each agent's history into verifiable claims about uptime, completed jobs, and stake age. An attacker planting a juniper grove of fake identities must fund each one separately, so the cost of a sybil swarm scales linearly while honest agents pay once and keep trading. One failed audit burns the bond and exposes the whole cluster.
